title: Invincible (2003)
synopsis: In Metropolitan City, Mark Grayson navigates the dual pressures of high school and his newfound abilities. His father, Omni-Man, is the world's most powerful hero, a legacy that now falls to Mark as he learns to control his own strength. The routine of classes and social anxieties is constantly interrupted by threats from the city's supervillains. Each confrontation tests his limits, forcing him to balance the chaos of adolescence with the immense responsibility of his powers. The skyline is a frequent backdrop for his clumsy, high-velocity learning curve.
